entities.summary: Max Ferdinand Bahrfeldt, ennobled as von Bahrfeldt in 1913, was a royal Prussian General of the Infantry, a local historian, and a numismatist of world renown. In the anglophone and francophone world, however, he was also notorious as the alleged perpetrator of atrocities in Charleroi, Belgium, during the German invasion of 1914.
